project_info.theme: Close-up eco-refill pouring shot for Hau Giang lotus cleanser

main_subject.detail: A close-up macro-style product shot capturing creamy cleanser pouring from a white Cocoon refill pouch into the neck of a pink bottle, with the bottom-right sustainability message '74% GIẢM NHỰA SO VỚI DẠNG CHAI'.
main_subject.style: Minimal beauty macro photography, clean eco-refill demonstration, soft pastel commercial visual

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'ECO-REFILL' and '74% GIẢM NHỰA SO VỚI DẠNG CHAI'. The pouch shows partial product branding 'the Cocoon ORIGINAL VIETNAM Sữa rửa mặt sen Hậu Giang soothing cl...'.
items: Top Left: Upper edge of the refill pouch cropped dramatically across the frame.
Top Right: Gold Cocoon logo and partial vertical product name on the pouch body.
Bottom Left: Open pink bottle neck receiving a smooth stream of pale cleanser.
Bottom Right: White outlined refill icon and large '74%' sustainability statement on a pink gradient field.
Center/Background: Soft pink-to-green pastel gradient with the pour stream as the main action line.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Smooth glossy highlights, creamy liquid definition, pastel gradient glow, clean minimalist clarity

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity macro beauty product photography
